subject: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan for FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@finservcorp.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan for FinServCorp

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Redwood and the demo. Great discussion — I wanted to send a short recap and a proposed POC/evaluation plan so your team has something concrete to share internally. Attached: FinServCorp_POC_Eval_Plan.xlsx (outline + success criteria) and a draft SOW for budget/approval conversations.

Demo highlights:
- Latency: steady 95th pctile ~120ms on sample workload using our deduped prefix cache.
- Cost: projected ~30% token-cost reduction using suggested batching and KV caching for your query mix.
- Integration: simple REST calls, SDKs available for Python/Node.

Proposed POC (4 weeks) — high level:
1) Goals / success criteria (examples in attached):
   - Throughput: sustain N concurrent inference streams at <=200ms p50 for 10k monthly active users
   - Quality: parity with existing baseline on 3 eval prompt sets (avg. F1 >= 0.78 / human pass rate >= 90%)
   - Cost target: unit token cost reduction >= 20% vs current hosted endpoint
2) Scope:
   - Ingest: up to 10k anonymized customer prompts (sample set we discussed)
   - Integrations: backend integration test, one interactive UI integration for key flows
3) Roles / ownership:
   - FinServCorp: Alice (PO) — owns eval signoffs; Tom (Eng lead) — infra/questions
   - Redwood: Marissa (AE) — program lead; Vivek (SE) — technical lead; Laura (CS) — onboarding and success manager
4) Timeline (target):
   - Week 0: contract + data access + baseline dataset handoff
   - Week 1: infra & model selection, quick smoke test
   - Weeks 2-3: run evals (automated + qualitative review)
   - Week 4: results review and go/no-go decision

Next steps (for this week):
- Please review the attached evaluation plan and mark any required success criteria changes by EOD Thu (Mar 4).
- If the plan looks good, I can send the SOW & PO instructions and a calendar invite for kickoff (propose Tue Mar 9 at 10 AM PST).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up prior to kickoff to align internal stakeholders.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinServCorp_POC_Eval_Plan.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf

Subject: Re: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan for FinServCorp

Thanks Marissa — really useful write-up and appreciated the clarity. A few quick Qs from our side before we circulate internally: 

1) Data access — for the anonymized prompts, we'll need a checklist of what counts as PII so our legal can sign off quickly. Can Vivek share a short list?
2) Model selection — you mentioned fallback variants for lower-cost routing. Can you confirm whether those will impact the eval quality numbers (i.e., will we be benchmarking the highest-capacity model or the cost-optimized variant)?
3) Timeline — our infra team has a sprint freeze the week of Mar 8. If we kick on Mar 9 that might be tight. Is it possible to move kickoff to Mar 16?

Also adding one more stakeholder who'll want visibility: Sandra Park <sandra.park@finservcorp.com> (compliance). We'll likely need to include a short SOC2/compliance summary for her review.

If you want to jump on a 20-min sync today to run through the changes before we mark anything internal, I can do 3 PM PST.

Best,
Alice
Product Owner, FinServCorp

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@finservcorp.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan for FinServCorp

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick review and great questions. Short answers below, and I attached a one-page data checklist we use for POCs (can forward to Sandra).

1) PII checklist: we only need de-identified prompts for evaluation. The checklist covers fields to strip (names, account numbers, IPs) and acceptable masking approaches. We do not need actual customer IDs. (Attached: poc_data_checklist.pdf)
2) Model variants & benchmarking: the evaluation plan defaults to the higher-capacity model family to establish quality baseline. For cost-optimized routing we'll run an additional pass with the suggested quantized variant and report delta metrics so you can weigh cost vs quality. We'll clearly label results as "baseline" vs "cost-optimized" in the final report.
3) Timeline: Mar 16 kickoff works fine. Updated proposed timeline in the attached Excel (I updated Week 0 to the week of Mar 15).

Technical asks for Tom/infra prior to kickoff:
- Short VPN or S3 bucket with sample dataset (5k prompts) by Mar 18
- Whitelisted Redwood IPs for test endpoints (I listed the CIDRs in the data checklist)

Happy to hop on the 3 PM PST sync today if that helps — I'll join and can share the checklist live.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
